Name: FS - Vanilla Accessories
Author: Texadaeus
Description:
[size=4]Patch to add the vanilla accessories from the base game to PeacefulEnd's[/size][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969] Fashion Sense[/url] mod[/size]
[size=3]
Just use your Hand Mirror [img]https://i.imgur.com/dRt6lC5.png[/img] and set your preferred vanilla accessories with your magic wings/scarves/backpacks/etc.﻿
[b]
Simply download the file and extract it into the mods folder.
[size=4]Of course, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url][/size] is required.

[/b][/size]

Downloads.Description:
Converted the vanilla eye patch from a hat into an accessory because why can't people with eye patches get to wear fancy hats too?
Also made it grayscale so you can change the colours using the Magic Mirror.
*Updated manifest to reflect correct version*
Zip format of the mod since some users could not extract the files from the original. [Use either the Main file or this one only]
